description: Shared acquisitions/contracts/artifacts/post-v1 fixtures. Bodies are UTF-8 text; body_hex gives raw bytes; body_parts is a list of parts where {repeat, count} stands for repeat concatenated count times. request_sha256 is the digest of a submit: SHA-256 of {"client":C,"handler":H,"operation":O,"args":A}, args canonical (keys sorted). heads are complete host request heads under the default broker head limits (8192 bytes, 1024 byte line, 32 fields), with the expected Content-Length or the fixed refusal code. http_responses are complete responses as the guest reads them, as a list of chunks ending in the server's close.

submit with nested args, keys sorted

invalid.name: an unknown field beside a missing one
an args key with a space
a nested args key too long
a result with a short digest
a result with an uppercase digest

closed denied with the longest code

invalid.name: ready with metadata keys out of order
ready with a bad metadata key
closed denied with an uppercase reason
closed denied with a reason too long
